name: 雛菜
text:
せっかく久しぶりに晴れたのに
今日レッスンか～
trans:
Even though it finally cleared up for the first time
in a while... 
We still have lessons today, huh～

name: 小糸
text:
し、仕方ないよ
元々そういう予定だったし
trans:
W-Well, it can't be helped. 
The lesson was planned from the start.

name: 小糸
text:
……やっぱり
ちょっと散っちゃったね、桜
trans:
...Looks the the cherry blossoms have started to 
fall a bit.

name: 円香
text: まあ、あれだけ雨が続けばね
trans: Well, the rain lasted for quite a long time.

name: 円香
trans: It can't be helped, can it?

name: 円香
text: むしろ、結構残った方だと思うけど
trans:
If anything, quite a lot of them
remain unscathed.

name: 小糸
text:
だけど、ようやく満開になった
ところだったのになって、思って……
trans:
It's just... 
I was thinking about how they had just finally 
reached full bloom, and now this happens.

name: 雛菜
text:
透先輩
なんでまだ傘差してるの～？
trans:
Toru-senpai, 
why are you still carrying an umbrella～?

name: 円香
text: 花びら、まだ雨で濡れてるっぽい
trans:
The petals are still wet from the 
rain after all.

name: 円香
text: 樹の下通ったら服が濡れそう
trans: Walking under the trees might wet our clothes.

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～
じゃあ雛菜も差そ～！
trans:
Hmm～
I'll open my umbrella up then～!

name: 雛菜
text:
小糸ちゃん
どうしたの～？

name: 小糸
text:
桜が降ってるの
雨みたいだな……って
trans:
The falling cherry blossoms,
kinda look like rain.

name: 小糸
text:
綺麗だけど
ちょっと残念だね
trans:
They are so beautiful,
yet it's a bit sad, isn't it?

name: 小糸
text:
桜が散るともう春が
終わっちゃうって感じがして
trans:
When the cherry blossoms fall, 
it feels like spring is coming to an end.

name: 雛菜
text:
いつかは終わるでしょ～？
なんでも

name: 小糸
text:
そ……れは、
そうだけど

name: 小糸
text:
…………だから
もう少し、このままがいいなって
trans:
I kind of wish things could just stay like this 
for a little bit longer.

name: 小糸
trans: Is what I feel.... I think.

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～……
よくわかんないけど
trans:
Heh～......
I don't really get it but...

name: 雛菜
text:
あ～、でも
だめなんだったっけ、小糸ちゃん
trans:
Ah～, but...
That's not good, is it, Koito-chan?

name: 雛菜
text:
わかんないこと、
わかんないままにするの
trans:
It's not good to leave things you don't know, 
unexplained.

name: 雛菜
text: でも雛菜は小糸ちゃんじゃないしな～……

name: 雛菜
text:
ま、いいや
そのうち考えとく～
trans:
Well, whatever
I'll think about it sometime～
